summary: Performance optimization and observability improvement in a single repo with clear requirements and multiple design concerns (state schema, routing logic, usage tracking); feature_with_architecture fits to ensure the state changes, orchestrator logic and usage aggregation all agree before coding.

steps.why: Extract the three distinct requirements (forced routing, usage tracking, state changes) from the detailed ticket.
steps.instructions: Focus on the three main requirements: forced_route logic, usage aggregation per node, and orchestrator skip conditions. Keep the acceptance criteria concrete.

steps.why: State schema changes, routing component design, and usage tracking across multiple call sites need architectural agreement before implementation.
steps.instructions: Design the state.usage schema with its reducer, the forced_route algorithm that delegates to broken_rules, and how usage flows from run_skill/bindings/ModelGateway through node updates to state. Address backward compatibility for runs saved before this change.

steps.why: Work spans route_rules.py, node.py, state schema, bindings.py, ModelGateway, and runner.py; breakdown into implementable slices needed.
steps.instructions: Break down by component: (1) state.usage schema and reducer, (2) forced_route in route_rules.py, (3) orchestrator skip logic in node.py, (4) usage collection in run_skill/bindings/ModelGateway, (5) logging and API changes in runner.py.

steps.why: Each story needs concrete file plans for state changes, the forced_route algorithm, usage propagation, and test setup with fake gateway.
steps.instructions: Provide detailed file plans showing exactly where usage gets collected (run_skill, bindings tool loop, ModelGateway), how the reducer merges counts, and how forced_route delegates to broken_rules without duplicating rules.

steps.why: Acceptance criteria include specific test cases for forced_route behavior, orchestrator skip conditions, usage aggregation, and backward compatibility.
steps.instructions: Map each AC to tests: forced_route cases, orchestrator model call skip, forced hop step format, usage accumulation across retries and tool rounds, backward compatibility for runs without usage.

steps.why: Loop feature_with_architecture: Deterministic merged_plan.md from ordered specs and story summaries.
Multiple artifacts (requirements, HLD, breakdown, stories, tests) must agree on state schema, forced_route contract, and usage flow.
steps.instructions: Verify consistency across all specs: state.usage schema matches in HLD and stories, forced_route algorithm agrees with broken_rules delegation, usage collection points match across HLD and implementation stories.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.
